concept.ai-tool.def: A function the model is allowed to call so it can do something text alone cannot - like check the weather or send a message - and read the result back.
concept.ai-tool-schema.def: The description of a tool - its name and typed parameters - that the model reads to know which tool fits and how to call it.
concept.ai-tool-call.def: The structured request the model emits to run a tool: the tool's name plus the arguments it needs, in the shape its schema asks for.
